RGB JPEG with an embedded ICC whose colour space isn't RGB (grey, CMYK) or that lcms can't parse: image pixels are fine but request colours are wrong or the request 422s.

Cause: jpegload keeps whatever APP2 ICC_PROFILE bytes the file has (libpng/tiff savers drop mismatched profiles, jpeg doesn't). InputColorManagement's unimported branch (lib/image_pipe/transform/input_color_management.ex ~85-90) keeps that profile on the sRGB frame without validating it. Output pixels are unaffected (libvips icc_transform falls back on an incompatible profile), but WorkingColor.values/2 → into_profile/export (lib/image_pipe/transform/working_color.ex) icc_imports + icc_exports every request colour through it.

Observed, 16x16 RGB JPEG with pixel [200,30,40] (verified by me for grey ICC: pad bg=00ff00 → [220,220,220]; plain format=png → [200,30,39]):
- Grey (sGrey) ICC: pad=5/bg=00ff00/format=png → [220,220,220] (want [0,255,0]); extend/w=40/h=40/bg=ff0000 → [130,130,130]; colorize=0.5,ff0000 → [165,80,84] (sRGB-ICC control [228,15,20]).
- CMYK ICC on RGB JPEG: pad bg=00ff00 → [192,208,11].
- 16 zero bytes / truncated CMYK / 600 random bytes as ICC: plain format=png 200, but pad/bg, extend/bg, colorize → 422 "invalid image transform" (want 200, at worst 415).
- Valid P3 ICC: correct. Grey JPEG with any of these: correct. CMYK JPEG with sRGB/P3/grey/garbage ICC: correct (icc_import falls back to the CMYK default) — EXCEPT when the loader/saver dropped the profile, which reaches pbmw.1's profile-less branch and segfaults (same bug as pbmw.1).

Fix direction: at input conditioning, validate or drop an embedded profile whose colour space doesn't match the interpretation or that lcms can't parse. Same seam as pbmw.1/pbmw.2 (input_color_management.ex non-importable/unimported branches); fix together.

Repro: decode a base64 input below to <dir>/src.jpg, then
  conn(:get, "/pad=5/bg=00ff00/format=png/src/src.jpg") |> ImagePipe.Plug.call(ImagePipe.Plug.init(allow_unsigned: true, sources: [path: [adapter: ImagePipe.Source.File, match: :path, options: [root: dir, root_id: "x"]]]))
and read pixel (0,0). Files and the script are also on git branch bughunt/2026-10-24-artifacts under bughunt/2026-10-24/verify/.
